title: Settlement Schedule for the Sum the Studio Keeps on a Closed Commission
content:
# Settlement Schedule for the Sum the Studio Keeps on a Closed Commission

The sum the studio keeps when a commission under Belrose Design Studio Custom Commissions is closed at the customer's request is the forfeit share of the quoted total, together with the share of the design fee booked to the commission that the studio keeps, together with the share of the repricings for the metal market booked to the commission that it keeps, the three added together before anything is taken back out of an upgrade credit and before any relief is applied.

This settlement is for a commission whose design stands approved when it is closed; a commission closed before its design is approved is outside it and is closed on the programme's own terms for that case.

## 1. The forfeit share

The forfeit share is taken against the quoted total recorded on the commission and not against what the customer has paid to date. The share is the programme's lighter forfeit share.

The share of the deposit the programme marks as non-refundable is not kept on a closure over and above the sum the studio keeps as stated here, and it sets no floor beneath that sum.

## 2. The design fee

The design fee booked to the commission is the amount of the commission's own entries under the design fee reason, taken as a positive figure. None of the design fee booked to the commission is kept: the share kept is 0 per cent of it.

## 3. The repricings for the metal market

None of the repricings for the metal market booked to the commission is kept: the share kept is 0 per cent of them.

## 4. An upgrade credit

Nothing is taken back out of an upgrade credit: the amount taken back is 0 per cent of the three added together.

## 5. The relief

The sum reached stands as it is: it is taken at 1, the whole of itself.

## 6. Rounding

The forfeit share of the quoted total, the design fee kept, the repricing kept and the amount taken back out of an upgrade credit are each rounded half up to two decimal places as they are worked out; the amount taken back out of an upgrade credit is a share of the three added together and is taken off that sum, and what remains is taken at the relief and rounded half up to two decimal places once.

## Worked figure on hypothetical inputs

A Belrose Bespoke Design commission whose design stands approved, quoted at USD 20000.00, with a design fee of USD 750.00 booked to it and USD 600.00 of repricings for the metal market booked to it. Under that programme the lighter forfeit share is 20 per cent.

| Step | Worked |
|---|---|
| The forfeit share of the quoted total | 20 per cent of USD 20000.00, that is USD 4000.00 |
| The design fee kept | 0 per cent of USD 750.00, that is USD 0.00 |
| The repricings kept | 0 per cent of USD 600.00, that is USD 0.00 |
| The three added together | USD 4000.00 |
| Taken back out of an upgrade credit | 0 per cent of USD 4000.00, that is USD 0.00 |
| What remains, taken at 1 and rounded half up to two decimal places once | USD 4000.00 |
